title: Cave system?
content: So I've been visiting MallWorld every night recently. Have been for about 30 years on and off, but more in probably the past 2 years than all the ones previous. For the past couple weeks, though, I've been in what seems to be a mall in a natural cave. The lighting is about as dim as it is in the mall. But instead of concrete walls, they are made of some sort of cave stone. There are still stores, but it feels as if it is deeper within the above ground superstructure of the Mall. It feels as if I'm stuck here recently. Has anyone experienced this place as well?
